checks.label: The native document opens and renders its own bytes — the local material state
No shared material is advertised before anything is published
The tray presents the exact selected passage — the selected-projection state begins here
The strip holds the exact passage, not a transformation of it
The strip names the document's exact source ref and selection-time revision
Publishing without a named publisher is refused before any envelope exists
A restricted projection with no audience refs is refused
The composed envelope is a real oi.projection/v1 at revision 1 (owner floor, not a desktop re-implementation)
The projection preserves the document's native subject ref and exact source revision
The projection carries its explicit restricted audience
The representation carries the selected material
The receiving field quarantines the arrival under a payload fingerprint before any decision
The receiving side records its admission decision as its own actor
Withdrawal is a new projection revision and deletes no source history
The receiver's admitted records survive the withdrawal — retained evidence, not revoked
Before the Return arrives the strip honestly shows an empty receiving field
The Return's producer is the receiving participant
The return discloses its shared-field lineage — admitted, and withdrawn by the publisher yet retained
The exact admitted material is shown before any decision
Inclusion lands through the owner's revision-checked operation on the exact reviewed basis
The strip names the advanced source revision the inclusion produced
The accepted contribution shows producer, human reviewer and entry anchor as distinct facts
All four material states are visible at once — local document, published (withdrawn) projection, admitted return, accepted revision
The document holds the admitted contribution with distinct native attribution
The document source revision advanced through the inclusion
The proposed entry anchor exists in the real document bytes
